remarks: This TURNKEY and STUNNING Townhouse is the one you've been waiting for!! Enter from the lovely porch and step into a beautifully renovated and decorated oasis. Gorgeous living room has 9 ft ceilings, hardwood floors and a cozy fireplace. Spacious kitchen complete with stainless steel appliances, hardwood floors, newer quartz countertops, tile backsplash and new refrigerator. Cozy and sun-drenched dining room with huge windows allowing nature to come inside. Serene primary bedroom suite with sliders and skylight, leading out to the lovely deck for your morning cup of coffee. Primary bathroom is luxurious with double sinks, shower and soaking tub. The chic new powder room completes the first floor. Upstairs you will find a second bedroom and full bath. The lower level, perfect as a family room and hang out space, is completely finished and has a second half bath and sink/bar area as well as interior access from the garage. So many improvements throughout including new deck, new skylight and newer windows and roof, as well as lots of closets and storage. Quiet location, surrounded by trees with ample visitor parking right outside the unit, adds to the allure of this special and awesome Townhouse. Walk to town for shopping, restaurants and dog walking and embrace the convenience and low maintenance lifestyle that Wilton Crest offers. A must see that will not last!!
